notes.title: Alpha 1.4.7
notes.content:
- fixed damage sounds not playing
- changed all clothing ids to woodland for woodland varient instead of forest sometimes
- fixed being able to see characters eyes when respawning in arena mode
- fixed clothing not showing after respawning in arena
- further reduced sound distancing (gunshots still sound incorrectly distanced)
- suppressed weapons no longer echo
- echo amount now dependant on distance (i.e shots right next to you wont echo at all)
- taking damage will now update bar faster making it seem more responsive
- taking damage will now also play a specific sound (not just the you getting hurt sound but a thud)
- new sounds for getting headshot too
- fixed sizing of steal icon being too small
- made all interaction icons slightly bigger
- fixed weapons not hitreging if serverside client has desynced
- fixed not being able to do damage if server is > 200m away
- fixed clients not being able to remove stat effects (like bleeding or being in safezones)
- being hit will no longer play a dirt being hit sound effect
- pretty sure i finally fixed the stuuuupid not being able to reconnect bug my goodness
- fixed big ass square at chunk 0 0 on client in arena mode
- fixed crack sound not playing with supersonic rounds
- fixed serverside mismatch with status effects causing incorrect results sometimes
- new whoosh sound effect in replace of crack to tell when your getting shot at by subsonic weapons
- further increased weapon sound dropoff
- fixed occasional disconnect if client connects just as server is sending entity data packets
- rpgs now are able to register sounds correctly with server
- hopefully fixed bug where server cant see client with weapon out
- fixed bug where typing in global chat in the vicinity of players would crash the server lol
- global chat now correctly shows ur namme
- fixed chat not working
- fixed vicinity being cut off in global chat
- lowered volume of hit effect soundsfired by other players
- moved mp5sd to medium size
- other players shooting bullet casings no longer make sound (saves on resources)
- increased sound range of internal suppressors
- fixed head hitbox being quite mismatched with actual position
- new rounds system in arena mode where u can no longer press respawn and will wait until everyone on other teams are dead, before teleporting all alive players back to their spawns
- backend fix for if network connection to client failure not causing server errors
- fixed bullets being stopped by player items
- arena mode will now set player spawns facing each other
- new arena mode subtype if all players are on the same team (or dont have one assigned) will default back to deathmatch insteadof round based games
- fixed players going flying after dying after respawning in arena mode
- fixed major hitreg issues that occur after respawning in arena
- new minor screen shake when being shot
- increased leaning angle
- camera height now dynamically scales with stance i.e lean amount will be greater if standing, less if crouched, even less ifprone
- aim punch still happens  even if in godmode/in safezone
- fixed bleeding not doing damage when in safezone
- added kits & new  console commands getkits, setkit & setkitall (set all players kit), thease are mainly for arena but can technically be used in the normal game
- fixed some settings changing FOV
- slightly reduced the maximum darkness players can be to make them more visible
- fixed being able to place weapons on the backboard of weapon workbenches lol
- fixed using weapon workbench bugging out
- arena mode will now refill all ur mags between rounds... yes this is an incentive to not hot drop mags
- fixed kit items attatchments spawning in the wrong position
- kits will now correctly chamber weapons
- kit magazines will always spawn full
- magazines will also always be created full when crafted in the main game
- clients can now pick their team in the respawn menu in arena mode
- fixed issue where clients would equip weapons & sometimes you couldent see them holding it (it would be on their back)
- added 38 custom & (mostly) balanced kits
- new setkitquality to limit quality of kits allowed by players (poor, low, medium, full)
- you no longer need permissions to use setkit on yourself in arena mode
- kits now ensure to remove your currently holding weapon
- new check for if invalid weapon equip request will now cancel equip animation (should mean no more holding empty weapons)
- arena now sets all weapons default safety off
- fixed sr25 spawning wrong quality stocks
- significantly reduced firerate increases for higher quality versions of weapons
- new dynamic motion vecots for scopes should remove blurryness when  moving & adding
- fixed scope going weird with longbarrel weapons in prone sometimes
- made tracers slightly thinner
- fixed check magazine not showing the actual name of the ammo instead of the id
- arena modenow heals u if u survive the round
- fixed players being overly dark
- fixed incorrect ak12 kit
- fixed adding person to the same team twice breaking things
- fixed light bouncing off rain
- fixed removing items sometimes disconnecting client
- setkit will always remove your primary
- redisabled texture streaming as its still causing issues :/
- fixed night vision switching state while typing in console
- fixed tundra water not having ice sheets
- readujusted tundra & desert biomes a lil
- adjusted ice colouring
- optimised distant chunk generation further
- changed charachter visuals slightly
- rearranged preset buttons
- kits now auto set hotkeys
- changing stance making optics blurry
- made unselected hotbar items more visible
- fixed some shotgun kits being invalid
- fixed izh18 having incorrect scope position
- fixed mosin having incorrect bullet textures
- increased clarity of realtime & help text
- serverside authority entities  now render at maximum entity distance always this means doors & player buildings will be visible for much further
- fixed  weapon workbench snapping to attatchment slots you cant attatch to
- fixed weapon workbench having difficult to selec slots sometimes
- fixed not being able to put a 6x on a weapon workbench
- removed ability to swap attatchments directly on weapon workbench (could be used to put incorrect attachments)
- new UI for using weapon workbench
- fixed placing weapons on workbench from holding making it not pickupable again
- increased aim punch
- fixed not being able to use RPG
- fixed mosin reload being incorrect
- fixed various issues with client disconnects
- arena now refills mags in gun
- weapons with internal ammo now spawn with full ammo in arena
- fixed dying while using a weapon bugging it out
- fixed weapons not hotkeying correctly with kits clientside
- fixed clientside weapon desync with deequiping weapons in area & dying with weapons
- fixed disconnect when dying if reloading loose ammo weapons
- fixed null ref if equipping a weapon as soon as it spawns
- fixed breach action weapons desyncing when dying while reloading
- fixed character not holding the correct weapon if loading into a server while other player is already holding weapon
- fixed being able to open inventory while respawning in arena mode breaking things
- increased amount of bouncing around when walking & adding
- fixed spawn being called twice in arena deathmatch mode sometimes causing incorrect states & twice the respawn time
- readusted weapon sway curves
- fixed compass not working for mosin
- new dynamic weapon sway curves system thats dependant on the type of optic/sight ur using and determines how much bounce you experience when moving
- buffed night vision across the board
- fix for null bullets causing issues on headless sever
- fixed status effects not correctly displaying & removing on client
- fixed dying while in inventory using an item not allowing u to use any after
- revisted different  hitbox damage
- fixed checking mag displaying the wrong amount by 1 bullet
- fixing using items in inventory instantly moving items behind
- fixed using items out of inventory then dying keeping the circle on your screen
- fixed heath  going straight back up as soon as  you die (visual effect)
- made lightning storm & stormy weather brighter at night

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.5 Arena Update
notes.content:
- fixed internally suppressed weapons (mp5sd, asval & vss) crashing ppl when u shoot at them lol
- fixed close fire not having correct distance value (always sounds right next to you)
- disabled gbuffer clearing
- disabled  full resolution depth prepassing
- fixed trying to unlock skills crashing client
- gave broken vehicles interior collisions
- fixed large workshop having incorrectly rotated objects
- changed tooltip to say capslock instead of alt for snapping
- fixed build snapping only working on double tapping
- added unlockallskills {steamId} command
- fixed spawn {steamId} or calling spawn from another player for vehicles/workbenches\enemies spawning it at the host
- significantly turned down TAA antiflickering (hopefully will reduce artifacts a lot)
- removed glass on sights having water droplets
- removed ability to pickup while reloading
- fixed night vision not turning off if you die
- significantly increased view distance for night vision
- fixed not being able to put night vision goggles on weapon workbench
- nvgs now work while using console
- interacting with a weapon equipped with a weapon workbench will now put the weapon straight on the workbench
- fixed pistol stock not being pickupable
- fixed bug where sometimes weapons dont chamber if spawned in serverside unchambered
- fixed asset warmup not showing the correct loading state sometimes
- fixed respawning mechanoids not redestroying them
- increased recoil signifcantly for when prone & crouching (prone especially would make basically any gun a complete lazer beam with a 50% recoil reduction), it still helps just less
- switched fallback  AA to SMAA from TAA, this doesnt look as good but hopefully should completely remove artifacting for people using FSR
- turned depth tolerance to 0 for SSGI, hopefully should further reduce artifacting
- fixed not being able to reconnect to servers after being disconnected (yay)
- syncronous mechanoids movement now being synced from server to client
- fixed fiveseven having incorrect attatchment points when using a weapon workbench or dragging in inventory
- added ability to put holosight on fiveseven
- items in toolbelt/backpack now wiggle when dragging around inventory
- fixed not being able to put conpensators on some weapons
- fixed single shot rifle not having barrel attatchment properly attatched to barrel, i.e if you put a suppressor on it and use the break action it would be floating
- changed render stack position of sharpness component to always layer after DLSS so DLSS injection point can be after PostProcess but still render with sharpness after
- fixed issue with unchambered weapons that dont have physical parts that move causing errors
- switched DLSS back to pre post process stack position
- fixed DLSS always being on the wrong quality setting i.e maximum permermance i.e the lowest
- added antialiasing setting (only applys for people not using DLSS)
- new icon for stealing from players
- increased FSR min screen resolution 10% -> 40%
- enabled TAA anti ringing (should help with artifcating )
- changed motion vectors of all scopes & sights (should also  help with over aliasing)
- changed from FSR to TAA upscale for dynamic resolution fallback (people with poo gpus)
- new dynamic AA scaling option which reduces anti flickering & asliasing when ADSing which should lead to much much clearer usage when using optics & sights
- changed way all non TAA rendering works on the backend
- enabled dynamic resolution on  scopes (better fps)
- turned motion vectors back on for sights (not optics)
- temporarily removed inital object render caching... this may significantly reduce ram usage
- reenabled texture streaming (still a client setting) , will hopefully also reduce ram usage
- fixed escape reloading menu if your not loading into a server
- new arena game type (heavily unfinished)
- new console commands to set teams for arena  game type
- new console commands to set team spawns for arena game type
- new consolecommand setarena area to autogenerate team spawns
- added auto positioning when dragging onto attatchments for weapon workbench
- weapon attatchments now use dynamic collider size
- lowered weapon workbench candle bridgtness
- area gamemode now spawns your charachter back with your items, others have a few seconds to grab shit off your body if they want

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.4
notes.content:
- fixed noclip not working corretly for clients
- fixed setting noclip for others not working
- fixed vaulting/jumping not doing a minstamina check
- fixed turrets throwing loads of errors when targeting others
- title screen rain / thunder now mutes when minimized
- ^ also fixed for ingame lightning
- fixed serverside commands ignoring permission level if client has any permissions
- fixed trying to use chat cooking the game lol
- fixed invalid permissions not working
- fixed picking up items sometimes dropping attatchments off it
- fixed trying to get into broken vehicles breaking game
- fixed broken vehicles not having ignition sounds
- fixed broken vehicles not having the wheel highlight
- setsettings will now refresh serversettings for all clients
- will now leave lobby after disconnecting i.e dont have to restart game after every leaving
- can now disconnect while trying to load / press escape to return to main menu
- fixed parachutes not having the correct serverside position
- fixed closing console typing in a lil ~ as it closes
- increased client entity refreshrate 8s -> 5s
- new audio distance falloff curve for gunshot sounds
- fixed getloation command not working
- you can now spawn entities on players with spawn {entitid} {steamId}
- getentity now shows entity id & datatags
- fixed sr25 not accepting small magazines
- magazines will now show ammo type
- fixed getentity not working
- fixed trying to open some doors as a client causing a disconnect
- fixed gunshot sounds cutting off after ~200m
- fixed chunk errors happening with client trying to load chunks before being ready
- changed sound falloff distribution of distant to close gunshots
- gunshots will now have added echo for other clients depentant  on if their fired inside or outside
- gunshots will also have significantly less sound range if fired from enclosed spaces
- guns now have a list of their attatchments in description
- fixed mp5 spawning with drum but not chambered
- increased amount of shake when rotating bags/toolbelt in inventory
- fixed being able to pickup toolbelts & add to your toolbelt which you could put more toolbelts on lol
- fixed toolbelt being the wrong size
- fixed not being able to sway toolbelts/backpacks by picking them up
- fixed floating player bug
- fixed quests not working
- fixed walker fire not being parented correctly when destroyed
- completely reorginized getentities list to be nicely organised (this took bloody ages because it was manual :/)

- fixed tasks not completing sometimes
- fixed map text showing before its open
- lowered min loot stage for small military & medical camps
- fixed chambering items/ loading mags on client making it disappear until u closed ur inventory & reopened it
- new sounds for military crate
- changed using items on the server to use only serverside based data i.e the server doesnt need to have the item loaded for it to be used (this would sometimes cause disconnects if picked up and used in quick succession)
- new serverside backend function for getting specific datatags for an entity, this will help significnatly for serverside stability

- slightly increased spawnrate of nvgs on helmets
- redesigned mp5 drum mag
- turned off lazersight volumetrics (wont have massive annoying red beam now)

- fixed vss & asval not accepting small magazines

- disabling auth skips assetwarmup for faster load times

- added correct spawnentites for vehicles

- fixed player state server desyncronization
- fixed clients not being able to see hosts character while host can

- you can no longer grab items off alive players

- fixed client player having collision (pushing its own player)
- fixed killing players disconnecting the host
- teleporting to a player with your weapon out will now corretly equip it
- fixed items showing mild highlight when looking at other players
- fixed workbenches that go out of network obfuscation range still acting as if they exist clientside
- you can no longer steal a players main weapon only things attatched to their toolbelt/backpack

- fixed eyes being too bright
- significnatly increased the rate of client data refreshing, meaning mostly no more waiting ages to beable to see players after teleporting to them (waiting for client data to refresh)
- fixed claimbox LOD being incorrect

- diconnect console command -> disconnect

- added spawns to large cardboard box pile
- added spawns to radio tower base
- distant & map chunks will now  render at full res
- item dropping now uses continuous dynamic collision detection... hopefully no more falling thru floor
- fixed camo netting having incorrect collisions
- increased camera height to stop shoving head into roof when jumping lol
- changed hesco barricades to int 64 format
- significantly increased turret lock on time again
- fixed constant landing bobbing while going down hills
- yep inventory litterally had 2x hover time lmao turned that back down
- all red brick sheds now fully clear grass
- large red barn now has doors
- new large wood door sounds
- doors are now placed based on the serialized position insead of the truncated position i.e no more weird rotations & whatnot
- added new doors to medium barn as well
- significantly decreased radio tower loot amount
- increased general industrial zones loot amount
- slightly increased hit sound distance
- updated pumping station room
- added collision to all concrete ground tiles
- 4 new power & radio tower structure objects
- increased console max charachters from 1000 to 10000
- significantly optimized trader poly count
- significantly optimized firekit holy shit it was using like a billion verticies lol
- realised lights were actually using an insane amount of verex count lol cool
- increased overcast base fog amount
- fixed NVGs not working
- fixed HESCO walls & sandbag walls rendering 4 times lol oops
- fixed tent cords having collision (annoying af lol)
- fixed trying to open inventory with compass equipped/while picking up item bricking ur game lol
- now gives notification when in safezone and  trying to equip weapon
- fixed turrets having incorrect health
- fixed turrets not taking damage
- fixed turret fire having a delay after being destroyed
- fixed walker smoke facing the wrong direction when destroyed
- slowed down the turn speed of all turrets
- mechanoids will now target you if you shoot them out of range while their inactive
- you can nowequip & deequip weapons  with ur compass out
- you can now also shoot your weapon while picking up / with compass out (itll be inaccurate af tho lol)
- fixed turrets activating multiple times if detected in different ticks
- destroying mechanoids now make sounds
- individual destryoing sounds for different mechanoid types
- fixed u dying before finishing loading in giving a black screen
- fixed up some items having incorrect sounds
- increased maximum stack size of 7.52x54  5 -> 10
- turrets now also use stealth mechanics
- added significant inaccuracy to turrets
- enabled GPU instancing for lots of assets (hopefully good fps boost and less stuttering)
- significantly reduced texture usage (will increase perforance and decrease ram usage)
- specialised item spawns now have a chance to ignore prioritiy spawns i.e you can still find a gun in the fridge or something but it will likely be food
- skuttlers now do a physics check... this means no more walking through walls... this will have some problems with serverside syncing but is fine for now...this also means they can get stuck on walls n shit, im gonna be working on some pathfinding stuff soon (pathfinding is really really hard with proc gen)
- you can now open stacked military boxes
- medium items can now also spawn in large slots (this helps with medium weapons for example being able to spawn in military crates)
- fixed flattening distance for lots of new structures
- new sounds for shooting at / walking on chainlink fences
- you can now put magazines in weapons by dragging it in in inventory
- fixed large wood doors having incorrect sounds
- turrets will now aim for your head, i.e if ur leaning around a corner with most ur body hidden it will still shoot at u
- fixed wheatgrass not flattening
- turrets will now activate much faster if shot at
- you can now remove magazines from weapons in inventory
- added a valuting mechanic when trying to jump over small objects like fences... its not like proper vaulting and more of a jump but will make getting over lil fences n shit much much easier
- realised contact shadows were turned off lol... this will make shadows much much nicer indoors (if you have it enabled)
- fixed tallgrass in title screen having the wrong texture
- wall refresh now happens immediately after loading in (show mean much less popping in of stuff when first loading in)
- fixed sun being visible indoors sometimes
- updated voltage box
- updated bridge textures
- fixed grass shadows being off even if turned on
- fixed being able to remove / checkmags with compass out
- improved glove bumpyness
- fixed swapping clothing from the ground not allowing you to pick that clothing back up
- vaulting speed is now also dependant on move speed
- fixed being able to vault through some windows that u definately shouldent beable to lol
- updated water towers
- updated highway & railroad bridges
- updatedhighway barricades
- stucture objects & fences will now be  included in asset warmup, should reduce stutters when loading new regions
- compass now holds in a higher position with gloves on to stop clipping
- reallocated texture size for loads of materials
- chunks no longer instantly deallocate all loaded assets on disable (async now)
- second pass memory reduction
- removed lots of mostly unused objects from asset warmup
- changed directional light to frustrum based on demand shadow caching... actual giving ~10fps increase which is amazing but has some big issues so gonna try fix that
- switched to IL2CPP backend code compiling.... this is highly experimental but will hopefully also give a large performance boost with runtime code compilation
- enabled incremental GC
- enabled dynamic render pass culling
- changed lighting tickrate 0.2f -> 0.1f
- demand shadow casting now uses subshadow index for deferred cascade based rendering
- chunks now do a special disance check for small objects & disable them... i.e objects in buildings wont be rendered from so far even if your chunk distance is turned up

- fixed gloves gittering when putting compass away
- added vaulting sounds
- added prone & crouching sounds
- improved sandy beach biome
- fixed worldgen crash when trying to load some medical tents lootpools

- sellpoints ui now shows from all distances

notes.title: Alpha 1.1.1
notes.content:
- safety changed off when clicking
- skill tree moves with left click
- map allows left click and does drag check to prevent unwanted markers
- added right click to inventory UI
- fixed inventory action menu closing on left click (instead of holding)
- added limits to teleporting to stop you cheeky mfs trying to teleport 9999999999km away
- if server has bounds doesnt allow teleporting/moving past bounds
- fixed console missing space in help menu
- heal command regens stamina
- all inventory actions take time (streamlined)
- added getsteamid command to console
- fixed vehicles not enabling kinmatics (not moving when you start engine)
- inverted controls for map (right click for pins) we will see if good change or not
- fixed container grass clipping
- fixed object spawns in big shedd
- fixed showing item highlights when transitioning from inventory
- fixed end cap on fuel tank junk not haaving collider
- fixed small hunting house having invisible wall
- fixed console showing input over text bar
- escape key now closes inventory instead of opening escape menu (up to interpretation)
- fixed dlss menu buttons being scuffed
- escape key now deselects current menu in main menu
- removed large CUBE at spawn
- fixed console updating cursor state in main menu (i.e cursor would sometimes disappear in main menu)
- jump delay moved from 0.1 -> 0.05, hopefully jumping feels more responsive
- slightly raised shipping container ceiling
- fixed issue with highlighting random items when highlighting other item
- mfw texture streaming option DOES work but just doesnt show up correctly cause some stupid engine bug...
- changed setweather to not be case sensitive (yes it was bugging me too)
- significantly increase base temperature change: 0.1 -> 0.25 (loose/gain heat 2.5x faster)
- decreased menu move distance to skill tree menu (when your switching menus white fog distance)
- fixed godmode console command
- fixed dying bricking your game
- completely fixed worldgen issues where chunks would completely brick... previously if procgen ran into issues would stop generation entirely, now just loggs to console and continues
- tapping r now loads mazaine into weapon (previously only hoding r would load)
- magazine no longer goes into the same slot equipped pistol is in if its in the first slot when removing mag
- added client setting slider to change speed of chunk loading, if ur pc is poopoo you can turn it down, if your jamie and want to turn your speed to 1000 and jump around like a spastic (and have a good computer) you can turn this up
- reduced minimum chunk distance slider to 1
- fixed animation bug while holding right click and changing firemode off safety
- the "tv" looking based thing in the water is due to again the basic unity system being buggy which youve gotta love so the only way to fix is by completely overhauling underwater effects... gonna push this one to the backburner for now
- added icons for left-side stats
- added string overrides for keybind controller (i.e 1 key wont read as Alpha1.. just 1 for example)
- added keybinding display when waiting for key (...)
- fixed bug where seat check wasnt detecting door state... was sending through netId instead of entityId for serverside check so couldent find door i.e you can actually get out of ur vehicle
- changed inventory action menu to not close when doing small actions (such as changing firemode/turning lights on/off)... subject to change
- added text to show when vehicle lights are turned on/off... tempted to change to physical switch in vehicle instead of keybind (x) but will leave for now
- player skin colour tied to SteamId again
- fixed large waterside cliffs in mountainous biome
- fixed large barn collider issues
- changed Building Snap Amount -> Placement Snap Precision (m)
- changed Overall Sound Volume -> Master Volume
- increase rockface texture resolution
- improved mountain biome worldgen making cliffs look more like this
- removed screen space ambient occlusion setting (doesnt have really any performance impact and makes the game look poopoo) when turned off
- (hopefully) fixed alot of grass spawning on the edge of river causing weird floaatyness.. may still be an issue though so keep an eye out
- fixed SSGI setting had backup renderer disabled which is why when you disabled it it looked poo
- fixed sandy beaches biome having weird looking grass
- changed all settings dropdowns to be verticle and have a blackout background behind (more readable)
- ui slider now shows 1.0 instead of 1 (more readable)
- fixed ui scale setting... its a little buggy but about to increase all the things we said are too small anyway
- increased chat size
- increased stat bars & hotbar default size
- increased stat effects size
- fixed soft reset not deleting structure data
- fixed heli crash not spawning in the proper location
- fixed heli crash spawning items in the air
- moved ui for server description box
New Feature: Debug Area
debugmode {off/items/workbenches/structures/objects/vehicles} in console... makes accessing most of the stuff in the game easy.... has a lot of things in the game but not everything, more coming soon
